decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The detached outbuildingshall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 118 Spring Grove Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).

Condition : 5 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, and due to the design and unique location, the proposed outbuilding would not harm neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the house and surrounding area and is considered consistent with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV B.1.1 and H.6.4.
description: Erection of a detached single storey outbuilding to rear of house.
